name: com.veilbreak.environment
description: Mobile veil cityscape for runner streets: a wet-street shader with puddles and an emissive reflection, lit facades with hashed windows, curbside props baked from project-authored models, a painted sky and skyline, ground fog, embers, pooled lamp lights and theme profiles. Streams on its own bounded SegmentStreamer; the host supplies distance and either a theme and the per-segment seed or a pure per-index segment plan.
